exposure: Time since delivery (day 1, day 3, day 42 of puerperium)
outcome: Uterine dimensions (longitudinal diameter, anteroposterior diameter, transverse diameter)
cohort: The study included 58 women who had uncomplicated singleton pregnancies.
finding: Uterus and uterine cavity dimensions on days 1, 3, and 42 of puerperium fall within a normal range and decrease as the number of days in puerperium increases.
